remarks: Welcome to this charming multi-family home located in the desirable Springdale district of Stamford, CT. With 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms spread over a spacious 1625 square feet, this property offers both comfort and convenience for your lifestyle.  Key features include a modern kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances, including a gas stove and dishwasher, creating a delightful cooking space. The open layout seamlessly connects the kitchen to a bright and inviting living room, perfect for gatherings. Enjoy the updated bathroom with contemporary fixtures and a soothing bathtub/shower combination. The property also boasts a cozy fireplace and laundry in unit for your convenience. Off-street parking is available, adding to the convenience. Close to department stores, library, shopping and train-station, this location is ideal. Don't miss out! Schedule a viewing today and make this lovely space your new home.
